direction: FRAMING PRIORITY — FOOTWEAR: Keep the frame low and focused on the worn shoes and lower legs; the model's face and full body are not needed. Use a close or medium-close view that clearly shows the shoes while preserving believable foot placement and proportions.
FRAMING PRIORITY — ACCESSORIES: Use close or medium-close framing around the body area where the accessory is worn; do not force a full-body shot.
FRAMING PRIORITY — BEAUTY: Prioritize the product and the relevant hand or application area; show the face only when useful for the actual product action.
FRAMING PRIORITY — WALLET: Prioritize the wallet and hands; the model's face and full body are unnecessary.
FRAMING PRIORITY — BAG: Keep the bag clearly visible in a natural hand-held, worn or placed composition; choose a medium or close framing that suits the selected action.
FRAMING PRIORITY — GADGET: Prioritize the device and the hands interacting with it; do not require a full-body or face shot.
